# Tiny Home Permit

> Tiny Home Permit (part of GetMyPermit) helps people in Western Australia get approval for tiny homes: local government approval for tiny homes on wheels (treated as caravans) and building permits for fixed tiny homes.

## Pages

- [Tiny home approvals in WA, sorted.](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/): Need approval for a tiny home in Perth or WA? We handle council approvals for tiny homes on wheels (up to 24 months) and building permits for fixed tiny homes.
- [Tiny homes on wheels: the WA rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-on-wheels-rules-wa): The rules for living in a tiny home on wheels in WA: treated as a caravan, council approval for up to 24 months since September 2024, conditions and decks.
- [Fixed tiny home permits in WA](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/fixed-tiny-home-permit): A tiny home on footings or a slab is a building in WA and needs a building permit. How the granny flat rules apply, modular tiny homes, and what we prepare.
- [Applying to your council for a tiny home](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-council-application): How to apply to your WA council for a tiny home on wheels: what goes in the application, the services councils check, timeframes and renewing your approval.
- [Tiny home prices in Perth (2026)](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/tiny-home-prices-perth): Tiny homes in Perth are advertised from about $26,500 to $192,800 in 2026. What's included, delivery and site costs, and the approval fees for homes on wheels and on footings.
- [Tiny home on wheels vs fixed tiny home](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/wheels-vs-fixed-tiny-home): In WA a tiny home on wheels is a caravan and a fixed tiny home is a house. Approvals, how long you can stay, the building code, size limits and which suits you.
- [How to move a tiny home onto your land](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/moving-a-tiny-home): Moving a tiny home onto your land in WA: the approvals you need first, the 2.5 m wide and 4.3 m high road limits, site access, cranes, the pad and connecting services.
- [Shire of Mundaring tiny home rules](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/shire-of-mundaring-tiny-homes): Shire of Mundaring tiny home rules in plain English: 5 nights in 28 days on wheels, up to 2 years while you build, and approving a fixed tiny home as a house or granny flat.
- [Guides](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to tiny homes approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://tinyhomepermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for tiny homes in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Tiny home on wheels from $1,450.
